# Task P1-07b: Song, artist, lookup and preview API

**Phase:** 1 · **Depends on:** P1-07 · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** S

## Goal
The song pipeline is reachable over HTTP in the *arr style: search for a song without adding it (`POST /api/v1/song/lookup`), add one by MusicBrainz or Deezer id, list/update/delete songs, list artists, change a song's album, and fetch a fresh Deezer preview URL for the add dialog. Controllers only map; everything else is in `ISongService`, `IArtistService`, `IIdentityResolver` and `IDeezerClient`.

## Deliverables
Namespace `Compilarr.Api.Songs`; `[ApiController]`, JSON, RFC 7807 errors; every endpoint needs the API key (default policy).

1. `src/Compilarr.Api/Songs/SongController.cs`:
   - `GET /api/v1/song?page=&pageSize=&sortKey=&sortDirection=&artistId=&monitored=` → `PagingResource<SongResource>` (P1-10's `PagingResource` + query helper and `SongResource` mapper — reuse, do not duplicate).
   - `GET /api/v1/song/{id}` → `SongResource` / 404.
   - `POST /api/v1/song` body `SongAddResource { mbRecordingId?, deezerId?, qualityProfileId?, libraryId?, monitored? }` → exactly one of the ids (else 400) → `ISongService.AddAsync` with `AddedBy` "api" → **201** + Location with the `SongResource` when added; **409** problem details with an extension `songId` when it already exists; **404** problem when the identity cannot be found; 400 for an unknown profile/library.
   - `PUT /api/v1/song/{id}` body `{ monitored?, qualityProfileId? }` → 200 `SongResource` / 404 / 400.
   - `DELETE /api/v1/song/{id}` → 200 / 404.
   - `POST /api/v1/song/lookup` body `{ term }` (non-empty, ≤ 500 chars, else 400) → `IIdentityResolver.SearchAsync(term, 20)` → `SongLookupResource[]` `{ source, mbRecordingId, deezerId, title, artistCredit, durationMs, disambiguation, versionFlags (wire names), firstReleaseDate, releaseTypes, albumTitle, coverUrl, isrcs, score, viaIsrc, existingSongId }` where `existingSongId` is the id of a song already holding that MBID (or Deezer id) — one query for the whole list. An unsupported input (Spotify/YouTube link) → 400 problem with the resolver's reason (call `LookupInput.Parse` first).
   - `GET /api/v1/song/{id}/albumcontexts` → `AlbumOptionResource[]` = the song's release options `{ key, mbReleaseId, mbReleaseGroupId, title, albumArtist, primaryType, secondaryTypes, status, date, trackNo, totalTracks, isCurrent }` plus a final entry `{ key: "singles", title: "Singles", … }`.
   - `PUT /api/v1/song/{id}/albumcontext` body `{ albumKey }` → 200 `SongResource` / 404 / 400 (unknown key).
2. `src/Compilarr.Api/Songs/SongApiResources.cs` — the new resource records above (`SongResource` stays in its P1-10 file).
3. `src/Compilarr.Api/Songs/ArtistController.cs` — `GET /api/v1/artist` → `[{ id, name, sortName, mbArtistId, deezerId, songCount }]`; `GET /api/v1/artist/{id}` → one / 404.
4. `src/Compilarr.Api/Songs/PreviewController.cs` — `GET /api/v1/preview?deezerId=` | `?isrc=` | `?songId=` (exactly one) → `{ url }` from `IDeezerClient.GetFreshPreviewUrlAsync` (for `isrc`: `GetTrackByIsrcAsync` → its id; for `songId`: the song's `DeezerId`, else its first ISRC); 404 when there is no preview; response header `Cache-Control: no-store` (the URL expires in ~30 min).
5. `docs/api/openapi.json` regenerated (`COMPILARR_UPDATE_OPENAPI=1 dotnet test --filter OpenApiSnapshot`).
6. Tests: `tests/Compilarr.Api.Tests/SongApiTests.cs`, `ArtistApiTests.cs`, `PreviewApiTests.cs` via `CompilarrAppFactory`, replacing `IIdentityResolver`, `IDeezerClient`, `IMusicBrainzClient` and `ICoverArtResolver` with NSubstitute fakes in the factory's service collection (extend the factory with a hook for extra service overrides if it has none — keep existing tests unchanged). **No test may reach the network.**

## Allowed paths
- `src/Compilarr.Api/Songs/**` (not `SongResource.cs` except to add a field if unavoidable), `docs/api/openapi.json`
- `tests/Compilarr.Api.Tests/SongApiTests.cs`, `ArtistApiTests.cs`, `PreviewApiTests.cs`, `tests/Compilarr.Api.Tests/CompilarrAppFactory.cs` (an override hook only)

- `src/Compilarr.Api/Songs/SongResource.cs`, `src/Compilarr.Api/Paging/*.cs`, `src/Compilarr.Api/Wanted/WantedController.cs` (P1-10), `src/Compilarr.Api/Profiles/*` (P1-08, error style)

- No new packages; no EF code in controllers.

## Acceptance criteria (each must be demonstrated)
1. `dotnet build -warnaserror` → 0 warnings, 0 errors; `dotnet test` → all pass (paste the summary lines).
2. `POST /api/v1/song/lookup {"term":"Daft Punk - Get Lucky"}` with a faked resolver returning two candidates, one of which is already a song → 200 with both, `existingSongId` set on that one only; `{"term":""}` → 400; `{"term":"https://open.spotify.com/track/x"}` → 400 whose detail mentions CSV.
3. `POST /api/v1/song {"mbRecordingId":"833f00e1-781f-4edd-90e4-e52712618862"}` (fakes: resolver identity with one album option; release lookup; cover resolver) → 201, `Location` header, body has `albumContext.albumTitle` and `albumContext.coverUrl`; the same again → 409 with `songId`; `{}` → 400; both ids → 400; an unknown id (resolver returns null) → 404.
4. `GET /api/v1/song?monitored=true&sortKey=title` pages; `PUT` flips `monitored`; `DELETE` → 200 then `GET` → 404.
5. `GET /api/v1/song/{id}/albumcontexts` ends with the `singles` entry and marks the current one; `PUT …/albumcontext {"albumKey":"singles"}` → the song's `albumContext.kind` is `pseudoSingles`.
6. `GET /api/v1/artist` lists the artist with `songCount` 1; `GET /api/v1/preview?deezerId=3135556` → `{ url }` with `Cache-Control: no-store`; no preview → 404; two parameters → 400.
7. All endpoints → 401 without the key; the OpenAPI snapshot test passes with the regenerated snapshot.
